name: Rush

whyMatters.en: Toronto trio that kept prog-length writing and instrumental virtuosity on rock radio through the 1970s–80s; Moving Pictures (1981) is the mass hinge.
whyMatters.zh: 多伦多三人组：1970–80 年代把 prog 时长写作与乐器炫技留在摇滚电台；Moving Pictures（1981）是大众铰链。

note.en: Side-long suite era; Peart lyrics + hard-rock riff chapters.
note.zh: 整面组曲时期；Peart 歌词 + hard-rock riff 章节。

note.en: Permanent Waves: reggae-tinged bridge inside prog-radio single.
note.zh: Permanent Waves：prog 电台单曲里的偏 reggae 桥段。

note.en: Minimoog hook, odd-meter drums, high tenor over Moving Pictures polish.
note.zh: Minimoog 钩子、奇数拍鼓、Moving Pictures 抛光上的高男高音。

interviewQuotes.text: What you own is your own kingdom.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Neil Peart

interviewQuotes.text: Three guys trying to sound like more.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Geddy Lee

lyricQuotes: Today's Tom Sawyer / He gets high on you
Begin the day with a friendly voice

shortBio.en: Lee / Lifeson / Peart prog-rock; Tom Sawyer is the synthesizer-era hit.
shortBio.zh: Lee / Lifeson / Peart 的 progressive rock；Tom Sawyer 是合成器时期热单。

body.en:
Formed 1968; Neil Peart joined 1974. 2112 and Hemispheres document long-form side suites; Permanent Waves and Moving Pictures compress prog into radio-length precision.

Tom Sawyer (1981) shows the mid-era mix—Minimoog hooks, odd-meter drums, Geddy’s high vocal. They prove a power trio can sustain prog ambition without a theatrical frontman brand.
body.zh:
1968 年组建；Neil Peart 1974 年加入。2112 与 Hemispheres 记录长篇组曲；Permanent Waves 与 Moving Pictures 把 prog 压成电台长度的精密曲。

Tom Sawyer（1981）展示中期混音——Minimoog 钩子、奇数拍鼓、Geddy 高音人声。证明三件套也能维持 prog 野心，无需戏剧化主唱品牌。

title.en: Prog ambition inside a power trio
title.zh: Power trio 里的 prog 野心

body.en:
Lee bass/vocal/keys, Lifeson arrangement guitar, Peart kit + lyrics. Moving Pictures (1981) compresses side-suites into radio-length precision.

Virtuosity without a theatrical frontman brand.
body.zh:
Lee 贝斯/人声/键盘、Lifeson 编曲吉他、Peart 鼓组+歌词。Moving Pictures（1981）把整面组曲压成电台长度精密曲。

炫技而无戏剧化主唱品牌。

title.zh: Rutsey 年 → Peart 三人组

body.en:
Pre-1974 John Rutsey debut. Peart joins 1974; classic citation starts at Fly by Night through Clockwork Angels.

Peak is Peart-era three.
body.zh:
1974 前 John Rutsey 首专。Peart 1974 加入；经典引用自 Fly by Night 至 Clockwork Angels。

峰值是 Peart 时期三人。

body.en:
Minimoog riff, Peart’s gated/odd phrasing, Geddy high tenor, Lifeson chorus guitar. Moving Pictures mass hinge.

Synth-era Rush teaching track.
body.zh:
Minimoog riff、Peart 门限/奇数乐句、Geddy 高男高音、Lifeson chorus 吉他。Moving Pictures 大众铰链。

合成器时期 Rush 教材曲。

body.en:
Lee covers bass + lead vocal + foot-pedal synths live. Lifeson favors arpeggio/chord color over shred contests. Peart expands kit and writes lyrics.

Three guys sounding like more is the method.
body.zh:
Lee 现场兼贝斯+主唱+脚踏合成器。Lifeson 偏分解/和弦色彩而非 shred 对决。Peart 扩展鼓组并写词。

三人听起来像更多人即方法。

body.en:
Peart’s autonomy lyric theme and Lee’s trio-arrangement line document Rush ideology: individual craft inside ensemble density.

Quotes label method.
body.zh:
Peart 的自主歌词主题与 Lee 的三人编曲线记录 Rush 意识形态：合奏密度里的个人工艺。

引语给方法贴标签。

title.en: Prog on rock radio, later metal cites
title.zh: 摇滚电台上的 prog，后来金属引用

body.en:
Tool and prog-metal acts cite odd meters and concept writing. Metallica-era metal nods to Peart kit ambition.

Rush keep prog on rock radio without theatrical costume rock.
body.zh:
Tool 与 prog-metal 引用奇数拍与概念写作。Metallica 时期金属点头 Peart 鼓组野心。

Rush 把 prog 留在摇滚电台，不做戏服摇滚。

note.zh: 同名首专；Peart 前的 hard-rock。

note.en: 2112 through Moving Pictures and beyond; classic trio.
note.zh: 2112 至 Moving Pictures 及之后；经典三人组。

note.en: Synth-era prog single as mass hinge.
note.zh: 合成器时期 prog 单曲作大众铰链。

note.en: Power-trio prog with dual-duty bass/keys and lyricist-drummer.
note.zh: 双责贝斯/键盘 + 作词鼓手的 power-trio prog。
